title: First Frost
hints: Ice is slippery. One forward and LoopBot keeps sliding until something stops it.

story.intro: PATCH: "Frostline. VANTA's drone came down on the Northstar Needle, and the heating's off. Everything is iced over. Careful where you step."
story.outro: PATCH: "Ha! One step, five tiles. Ice does the walking for you."
